title: Export private key
purpose: Encrypt a private key with a password and create a complete document.

title: Export encrypted state
purpose: Serialize encrypted state without decrypting the private key.

title: Parse document
purpose: Read JSON text or bytes and validate the resulting document.

title: Validate document
purpose: Validate an in-memory value and return the normalized document.

title: Serialize document
purpose: Write a validated document as canonical JSON.

title: Unlock document
purpose: Decrypt the private key and verify that it matches the document public key.

title: Read summary
purpose: Read format, version, label, and public-key metadata without secrets.

title: Handle errors
purpose: Handle predictable failures through stable error codes.
